patch_description: Broaden the deterministic restart portfolio while retaining the proven perturbed 3-by-3 starts. The max-min landscape has many isolated basins, and lattice-only initializations tend to repeatedly enter similar local optima. Six additional starts use staggered hexagonal and rotated-grid geometries, which better reflect the near-isotropic spacing and rotational structure commonly useful in Heilbronn configurations. Each receives small deterministic jitter to remove exact collinearities. This increases global-search diversity without changing the established coordinate optimization and final strict polishing stages.
